summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container in the rdflib SPARQL plugin. Changes: Update(prologue, algebra) class in sparql/sparql.py; translateUpdate returns Update using the translated prologue; evalUpdate iterates update.algebra; processor gains prepareUpdate (sets _original_args) and passes containers through; prepareUpdate exported from sparql/__init__.py; new test/test_sparql_prepared_update.py. Deviation: for an empty request translateUpdate returns Update(None, []) instead of the bare [] the spec asked to keep, because evalUpdate now reads .algebra and a bare list would break processUpdate(""). Needs your decision. Tests were not run, per instructions. test_dawg.py is unchanged and should remain compatible.
